Container.Name: x402-facilitator-syd
Container.Overview: Self-hosted x402-rs facilitator (Phase 1, unraid-syd leg of the active/active pool). Image pinned by OCI index digest (v2.0.2, revision 0b14f39). Serves Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) and Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Config mounted read-only at /app/config.json; secret via /app/.env (dotenvy), NOT visible in docker inspect. Runs as root for the Tailscale hook; the Rust binary drops nothing (image default user is root). Tailscale hostname x402-facilitator-syd, joined to pygmy-bramble; ingress via Caddy on caddy-linode. Auth key is a placeholder - Gary sets the real key via the Unraid UI. EVM_PRIVATE_KEY must be placed in the mounted .env before start; container fails closed if unset.

Config.Name: Env File (secret)
Config.Description: Secret env file loaded by dotenvy - holds EVM_PRIVATE_KEY. Must be chmod 600 on the host.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent host-mounted directory for Tailscale state (CA_TS_FALLBACK_DIR=/app/data). Without this mount the state is ephemeral inside the container, so a restart forces a fresh login with a single-use auth key that is already consumed.

Config.Name: Tailscale Fallback State Directory
Config.Description: Persistent container directory for tailscale state (falls back when Tailscale State Directory is blank)

Config.Name: ORG_CMD
Config.Description: Original Docker command (none - the binary is the entrypoint)
